title: Peer Evaluation App
desc: A full-stack educational platform focused around students grading each other on group or solo projects. It pairs a React frontend and Flask backend with role-based access control, PostgreSQL relational data base, and containerized microservices backing the grading logic.

title: Seedra
desc: A C++ API that lets Minecraft seed finders and world-analysis tools. It replicates the Legacy Console Edition world generation pipeline to generate biomes, structures, loot, and terrain with high accuracy and performance.

title: Seedra Engine
desc: A C++ 3D renderer for that lets player explore Minecraft Legacy Console Edition worlds for any world seed. Built on top of Seedra, it accurately recreates terrain and biomes with smooth performance, camera navigation, and shortcut hotkeys.

title: Legacy Converter
desc: A command-line tool that lets Minecraft Legacy Console Edition players migrate their worlds to Java Edition. It supports versions 1.12 through 1.15, with planned support extending to latest release.

title: Legacy Minecraft Mapper
desc: A Qt/C++ desktop app lets Legacy Console players convert and explore their worlds without the command line by wrapping the Seedra and Converter APIs into a single GUI.

title: Tascade
desc: A frontend web app that makes daily task management engaging and fun for productivity seekers. It turns a scrum board into a progression system where you earn points for completing tasks and unlock custom themes and fonts.

title: Steady Plan
desc: A fullstack web app that helps small teams organize projects and track progress together. It uses Kanban boards, task assignment, and PHP/MySQL backend to keep everyone aligned.
